text:
Lina (CS): Heads-up: prepping a focused pilot ramp next week (5 seats). Goal = move customers past the "activation cliff" in the first 72h and capture renewal signals. Need owners for invites, note-taking, and immediate triage.
Marcus (PM): Proposed cadence: two 30-min sessions per customer (setup + feedback). Can we bundle into 3 days to keep momentum?
Irene (SE): I can cover live setup for 3 of the seats. Will bring a minimal checklist + a short troubleshooting card. Link to runbook: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/pilot-setup
Jon (SRE): I'll standby for perf and quota questions. If a latency/blocker surfaces, I can spin a short-term capacity increase for the demo window.
Lina (CS): Owners needed: invites & follow-ups (me), notes + quote tagging (volunteer), triage of "deal-signal" items (SSO, data residency, throughput). Who can own notes?
Irene (SE): I'll take notes for the first two sessions. Quick SSO config note for Okta: set `provisioning.scim.enabled=true` and ensure callback URL uses https. Snippet: `provisioning:
  scim:
    enabled: true`
Marcus (PM): Let's capture an "activation runway" metric (hours from invite to demo success). Also a 1-10 NPS-ish LTR and a binary "renewal risk" flag. If renewal risk = yes, tag with reason and urgency.
FeedbackBot: Created calendar events: Pilot Ramp Day 1 & 2. Attached micro-survey: https://forms.redwood.com/pilot-ramp-2025. Meet links added.
Lina (CS): Post-call flow: send Loom + survey within 12h, compile top-4 friction items and map to quick fix vs product backlog. If there's a P0 infra item -> route to runtime oncall with the triage matrix.
Jon (SRE): For throughput complaints, capture sample logs and request id. If repeated across two customers, we escalate to perf team and instantiate a hotfix run.
Marcus (PM): I'll make a tiny triage board template: columns = Observed, Quick Win, Backlog, Renewal Risk. We'll use it to hand off to product & eng.
Lina (CS): Nice. One more ask: please flag any "legal/data residency" hesitations explicitly — those are immediate enterprise renewal signals.
Irene (SE): Noted. I'll include a short checklist for EEA customers (region pinning + KMS hints).
Lina (CS): Great team. I'll drop invites in 10m and post the roster + owner matrix. Ping me if you want to sit on any live sessions. :rocket:
